name: Add-on / modular feature priced separately but grouped
what_it_tests: Add-on SKUs (e.g. GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows, PhishLabs Dark Web add-on) are priced separately and additively but grouped with the primary product line; no special override unless parent bundle pricing gates it
proc_mechanism: Product2.Bundle='Add-On'/'Bundle Component'; parent SKU link; additive line pricing
expected_behavior: Add-on line included in same group as primary product; no override unless bundle gate
test_setup: GoAnywhere Essentials (base 25k) + Advanced Workflows add-on (12.65k) as two lines in same group, subscription
